name: langfuse
description: Sends Claude Code session traces to Langfuse via a Stop hook — per-turn traces with prompts, generations, tool observations, and backdated timestamps. Includes a SessionStart tripwire that marks programmatically-spawned sessions.

LANGFUSE_BASE_URL.title: Langfuse Base URL
LANGFUSE_BASE_URL.description: Langfuse host. Use https://us.cloud.langfuse.com for US, https://cloud.langfuse.com for EU, or your self-hosted URL.
